Rippling pricing in 2026

Rippling publishes one number: plans start at $8 per employee per month, with a monthly base fee on top. The base fee and each module (Payroll, IT/Device, Performance, Recruiting, Benefits Admin) are priced in the quote, and Rippling says your total depends on the products and services you choose. The $8 floor is from rippling.com/pricing, read 14 November 2026 and again on 24 November 2026. Enter your Rippling quote under “Your quote” in the ledger to compare it with the vendors that publish.

How the price is built

Stack-priced. The $8 floor is the only number Rippling publishes; everything above it is set in the quote.

What to get priced in writing

  • The per-employee rate for each module you take, as separate lines
  • Any monthly base or platform fee, stated separately from the per-employee rate
  • Whether any charge is per payroll run rather than per month, and the rate
  • The one-time implementation fee and what it covers
  • The contract term, any seat minimum, and the annual renewal increase cap in writing

For scale, the vendors that do publish an HRIS seat rate list from $3 to $29 per employee per month (every published rate). Enter your Rippling quote under “Your quote” in the ledger to set it against them over 3 years.

What does Rippling publish about price?

Only the floor: "Rippling plans start at $8 per employee per month, with a monthly base fee." It does not publish the base-fee amount, any per-module rate, or a price for a named bundle.

What moves a Rippling quote above $8 PEPM?

Three things Rippling names itself: which products you add, the number of employees (most products are priced per employee per month), and the monthly base fee. Ask the rep to price each module as its own PEPM line and to state the base fee separately, so you can compare the quote against the $8 floor.

How are modules priced?

Per module, per employee per month, in the quote. We do not publish per-module figures for Rippling because Rippling does not. Enter the module total from your quote as the add-on rate in the ledger.

How does Rippling PEPM scale on renewal?

Rippling does not publish renewal terms; they are set in each contract. Ask for an annual renewal cap in writing before you sign, then set it in the ledger to see the 3-year effect.
